items.definition:
relating to the geographic location of features on Earth

extending back beyond memory or record

relating to or performed by laparoscopy (a surgical procedure)

lively and bold; saucy

extremely high

concerned with theory rather than practice

not showing fear or hesitation in the face of danger or difficulty

expressing one's feelings or thoughts unselfconsciously and without restraint

not attempting to impress others with an appearance of greater importance, talent, or culture than is actually possessed

curious or unusual in a way that provokes dry amusement

relating to the Eucharist (Christian sacrament)

grimly mocking or cynical
